ITEM.PTXT: An L-shaped combination light incorporating 4-bulb irregular-shaped multi-reflector & projector type headlights, clearance lights and front turn signal lights has been adopted.
Front fog lights mounted on the front bumper have been adopted as standard equipment on all models.
Discharge headlights have been provided on the G grade for excellent design and visibility.
LED side turn signal lights built into the outer mirrors have been adopted as standard on all models to ensure visibility.
